brand_facts: Assembly Maker is free browser-based software for creating interactive 3D assembly instructions and digital product manuals.
It imports STEP, STP, GLB, and GLTF models.
Authors can record a sequence, set camera views and part visibility, write instructions, and add labels, notes, and arrows.
Authors can preview a manual, publish a browser-based viewer, and export PDF or WebM output.
An .amaker file is the portable editable project format.
The site contains working drone, robotic arm, automated guided vehicle, servo, motor, and mechanical assembly examples.
Do not claim pricing tiers, certifications, integrations, analytics, AI features, or file-format support beyond these facts.
